text: Under the affine gap penalty model, what is the cost of a single gap of length L?
choices: gap_length × gap_extend, with no fixed opening cost
d × gap_length, where d is a single fixed per-residue cost
explanation: The affine model charges a one-time gap_open cost plus a per-residue gap_extend cost for the remaining (L-1) positions, reflecting that a single indel event typically opens a run of gaps. The last option describes the simpler linear penalty model (cost = d × L), and the other two options invent multiplicative formulas that don't correspond to either the linear or affine model used by the Gotoh algorithm.
